recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants multiple computable policy bases in current R6, handle that through current unresolved Consent policy clarification work rather than through this already-applied DSTU2 cardinality request.
issue_request: FHIR-11047 was a Published CBCC DSTU2 change request asking to change Consent.policy from 1..1 uri to a repeatable policy reference so a consent could reference multiple organizational, state, or federal policies. Its Persuasive with Modification resolution says the requested change had already been made by CR 11058.
initial_application: The original application was through FHIR-11058/GF#11058 rather than a separate FHIR-11047-named commit. Commit 612068c15886b6624c44de5d656417bcfa7d76d3 applied Consent STU3 updates including GF#11058; the readable spreadsheet after the commit shows Consent.policy 0..* uri and Consent.policyRule 0..1 uri, while the parent had Consent.policy 1..1 uri.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-32817 deliberately replaced the older .policy/.policyRule design with regulatoryBasis 0..* CodeableConcept, policyBasis 0..1 Reference/uri for the single computable policy an organization will enforce, and policyText 0..* DocumentReference for human-readable policy text. Current source/fhir.ini includes Consent as an active resource, and current source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml matches that later final model. Triaged R6 questions about Consent policy terminology were found but are not final decisions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is appropriate because making Consent.policyBasis repeatable would conflict with the later final FHIR-32817 structure; the current repeatable elements for multiple policy context are regulatoryBasis and policyText.
